name: answer-markdown
about: The answer text in every Markdown form the chat renders, with school names that link to the map; one specialist, so the bubble is Spend & Schools'

name: brief-chart
about: A brief visual inside the bubble: two tiles and one bar chart, with Numbers on demand and the steps fold

name: brief-table
about: The latest-activity answer: three tiles and the most recently active stalls table inside the bubble (scrolls sideways on a phone)

name: report-card
about: A full report card from two specialists: tiles with deltas, a bar, a line and a stacked chart each with Numbers, a table, notes, Copy and CSV; progress first shows the routing card

name: partial-retry
about: A partial answer: one specialist failed; the routing card marks it, a line names it with a Retry chip, the other's brief chart still shows

name: attribution-one
about: One figure from one specialist: no visual, the bubble is that specialist's with its source in the footer

name: refusal
about: A refusal: the refusal style, no routing card, two suggestion chips

name: scope
about: A scope answer: a source not loaded yet, with a suggestion chip

name: clarify
about: A clarifying question back to the viewer

name: loose-rows
about: A table whose rows are objects keyed by the column names

name: loose-points
about: A bar chart whose points are {label, value} objects

name: loose-numbers
about: Tiles whose values are formatted strings with no unit: they read S$7.57M and 33.4%

name: pie
about: A pie chart, drawn as a bar chart of the same values

name: md-table
about: A Markdown table without outer pipes in the reply text

name: escaped-newlines
about: A reply whose line breaks arrive as the two characters \n: a bold line and a two-item list
